notes: WhatsApp: link the company's WhatsApp in Settings > Notifications and the acknowledgement link and the signed PDF copy go to the employee's mobile as well as their email. Employees have a Mobile field for it. Signing is faster: the signed copy is sent in the background, so the page answers straight away, and the submit button holds while it works so nobody signs twice. The 'Acknowledged' message on the sign page is now a large green banner the page scrolls to, instead of a line of plain text under the button.
